info.title: Career Arena API
info.description: Career Arena Exam Arena API. This checked-in contract covers implemented `/api/v1` routes. Compatibility policy: adding an optional request/response field or endpoint is backward compatible within v1. Removing/renaming an endpoint or method, making a field required, changing a field's meaning/type, or removing/renaming a response field is breaking; introduce a new versioned route for breaking changes and keep the old contract during a documented migration window. Announce deprecations with the OpenAPI `deprecated` flag and a sunset date in the operation description before removal.
